integrity: The theorem relies on a finite-state proof and exact integer matrix identities, with a standalone reproducible verification program. The numerical Perron root is approximate; there has been no independent review.
scientific_limitations: The exact maximum and complete extremizer enumeration concern one cyclic rotation of one nonwrapping four-position window. Enumeration and entropy are for ternary inputs; no full nonmaximum sphere spectrum, code construction, or coding-rate gain is claimed. Equivalent results in unindexed or unpublished literature cannot be ruled out.
title: Ternary four-window cyclic-burst maximizers: exact census and entropy
